name: rica-theme-monorepo
description: Monorepo for RICA Haircare and Rica WAX Shopify themes

scripts.build:rica-haircare: npm run build:ts && node dist-tools/build.js rica-haircare
scripts.build:rica-wax: npm run build:ts && node dist-tools/build.js rica-wax
scripts.push:rica-haircare: npm run build:rica-haircare && cd dist/rica-haircare && shopify theme push
scripts.push:rica-wax: npm run build:rica-wax && cd dist/rica-wax && shopify theme push
